# JPEG File

## Summary
The raster-image specialization for JPEG.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `RasterImageDef`. Adds no fields of its own — `width`, `height`, `exif` and `colorProfile` come from
`RasterImageDef`. What it contributes is the extraction pass: it reads the first
64 KB, which is wide enough to clear large EXIF/ICC segments and still reach the
SOF frame header, then fills dimensions plus EXIF and colour profile in one go.

Accepts: `.jpg, .jpeg, image/jpeg`

## Example
```ts
import { JpgDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/jpg-image-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(JpgDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
